entries.source: No pudimos verificar tu identidad, así que cerramos tu sesión por seguridad. Inicia sesión de nuevo.
entries.es: No pudimos verificar tu identidad, así que cerramos tu sesión por seguridad. Inicia sesión de nuevo.
entries.en: We could not verify your identity, so we signed you out for security. Please sign in again.

entries.source: No pudimos verificar tu código después de 3 intentos. Intenta iniciar sesión de nuevo.
entries.es: No pudimos verificar tu código después de 3 intentos. Intenta iniciar sesión de nuevo.
entries.en: We could not verify your code after 3 attempts. Try signing in again.

entries.source: We are working to set everything up for you
entries.en: We are working to set everything up for you

entries.source: ¡Tu cuenta se creó correctamente! Inicia sesión para continuar.
entries.es: ¡Tu cuenta se creó correctamente! Inicia sesión para continuar.
entries.en: Your account was created! Sign in to continue.

entries.source: Esta cuenta tiene verificación en dos pasos activada. Ingresa el código de tu app autenticadora.
entries.es: Esta cuenta tiene verificación en dos pasos activada. Ingresa el código de tu app autenticadora.
entries.en: This account has two-step verification turned on. Enter the code from your authenticator app.

entries.source: We will never share your email with anyone else.
entries.es: Nunca compartiremos tu correo con nadie más.
entries.en: We will never share your email with anyone else.

entries.source: We will never share your password with anyone else.
entries.es: Nunca compartiremos tu contraseña con nadie más.
entries.en: We will never share your password with anyone else.

entries.source: You do not have an account? - Click here
entries.en: You do not have an account? - Click here

entries.source: We are building up your dashboard and data
entries.es: Estamos armando tu panel y tus datos
entries.en: We are building up your dashboard and data

entries.source: Type your full name or alias.
entries.es: Escribe tu nombre completo o tu alias.
entries.en: Type your full name or alias.

entries.source: The password must have at least 8 characters.
entries.es: La contraseña debe tener al menos 8 caracteres.
entries.en: The password must have at least 8 characters.

entries.source: The password must have at least one capital letter.
entries.es: La contraseña debe tener al menos una letra mayúscula.
entries.en: The password must have at least one capital letter.

entries.source: I agree to terms and conditions
entries.en: I agree to terms and conditions

entries.source: You have an account already? - Login here
entries.en: You have an account already? - Login here

entries.source: Removed from Gastify. Your device or password manager may still keep its own copy - delete it there too if you don't want it anymore.
entries.es: Se quitó de Gastify. Tu dispositivo o tu administrador de contraseñas puede seguir guardando su copia: bórrala allá también si ya no la quieres.
entries.en: Removed from Gastify. Your device or password manager may still keep its own copy - delete it there too if you don't want it anymore.

entries.source: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of your password - Gastify never sees or stores the biometric/PIN itself, only proof it unlocked your device.
entries.es: Entra con Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello o una llave de seguridad en vez de tu contraseña. Gastify nunca ve ni guarda tu huella ni tu PIN, solo la prueba de que tu dispositivo se desbloqueó.
entries.en: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of your password - Gastify never sees or stores the biometric/PIN itself, only proof it unlocked your device.
